question: Why does Bhairava praise the goddess for asking about a matter rare even for gods?
premises: He states that he has been asked a question.
The matter asked about is hard to obtain even for the gods.
inference: Bhairava praises the goddess because her question concerns knowledge rare even among the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O Great Goddess; you have asked me about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
